notes.title: Time to Rock the Casbah! "The Clash" ControlRoom update is here!
notes.notes:
Our biggest update yet is now LIVE, so you should stay (not go).

https://media.giphy.com/media/x6Ayu0NeEo1Ik/giphy.gif
 
We are excited to announce the addition of the highly requested Desktop Monitor tool. If you are running ControlRoom VR on a PC with a discrete GPU, you can now bring up your DAW screen within ControlRoom VR on a virtual monitor. It can be resized from iPad- to wall-sized. Rock the taskbar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35980786/6e6df099b76f95dfcef3f82d08befacda4bc61d0.png

Next, we have overhauled the on-boarding experience with a brand new non-linear "playground" style tutorial. Play with the various VR tools at your own pace with brand new built-in sounds, without the need to connect to your DAW. You'll also find short instructional videos and additional information that explains how best to use each tool.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35980786/b4ff6e1e3cd93f0047dd9b3442ce94639348a230.png

Lastly, we have updated our pricing structure to make things much simpler for our users. Now, the ControlRoom Hub and Plugins are a FREE download from persp3ctive.com, and the ControlRoom VR app is a $49 purchase on the Oculus and Steam Stores.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35980786/27686f979013fdb2b87eca968a0ace9da6fbf690.png


We fought the DAW and the DAW won  : ) 

https://media.giphy.com/media/G7WAibt5zO5tC/giphy.gif

notes.title: New ControlRoom Amadeus Update!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce the new Amadeus update to ControlRoom!
https://media.giphy.com/media/12Tfwx0eKevrsA/giphy.gif

The focus of this update is to provide users a more streamlined tutorial experience and to give users greater control over the ControlRoom Channel Plugin. These additional controls take the form of a new  EQ controller  and Pyramid Compressor.

EQ Controller:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35980786/944626bdccce31ce2c3cb0c5b7c2859d8cee931d.png
The EQ Controller allows users to more easily manipulate the EQ subsection of ControlRoom Channel Plugin via a 3D, colorful line-based interface. 

Pyramid Compressor:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35980786/55714cb2dade15a4346e5f2b8163c18c6b3067fb.png
The Pyramid Compressor gives you the ability to adjust ratio, threshold, and other compressor inputs through an innovative Pyramid-shaped interface.  

To see and hear these tools in action, check out the video below.
[previewyoutube=NJavV7zyDgw;full][/previewyoutube]

Where can I find this update? ControlRoom is not on Steam.
ControlRoom is not currently on Steam, but it is available on the Oculus Store. ControlRoom will be available on Steam on January 7th, 2019.

We want to hear your feedback!
At Persp3ctive, we are always trying to provide our users with the tools they need most. Many of the design decisions we made in this release originated from feedback received during our playtest parties or from our feedback form.

Want to help shape the direction of ControlRoom? Comment below or use our feedback form.

Having an issue with the new update?
See our User Manual.
 If you cannot find your answer there, see our Support Page.

Important Note
If you are using a previous version of the ControlRoom Hub and Plugins, you will need to download the latest version of the Hub and Plugins to use this version of ControlRoom. You can do so here: 
Rift Users: Visit this link.
Quest Users: Visit this link.

Complete Change Log: 
 Innovative new pyramid interface for ControlRoom Channel Compressor; adjust the most important compressor parameters in a brand new physical way.
 New Plugin Tablet provides full control over the ControlRoom Channel DAW plugin’s EQ and Compressor sections.
 New, streamlined VR tutorial.
 Updated icons for ControlRoom VR and Hub.
 HUB version checker that checks the Hub's compatibility with VR and Plugin components.
 Updated loading screens.
 Double-click VR tools to reset them to their default positions.
 Handle that allows you to move the Console.
 Password reset link in Hub login page.
 Auto-connect VR and Hub functionality.


Thank you for being part of the ControlRoom community!
https://media.giphy.com/media/mGj3SVN7xbPQ4/giphy.gif
